source_offer: The unmodified covered PEM source is distributed beside this manifest; upstream release and source project are linked above.
renewal_policy: Manual verified version/hash update through review; no runtime download or trust-on-first-use.
composition_notes: 3 upstream self-issued trust anchors use SHA1 self-signatures; not a change to TLS peer verification.

6 upstream self-issued CA certificates have legacy nonpositive serial numbers and emit cryptography deprecation warnings. The PEM is retained byte-for-byte; runtime pin validation does not depend on that parser.
diagnosis_scope: Local diagnostic psql child only; not an app dependency or a production deployment approval.
